task: Write a Python function get_user_by_email(email) that fetches a row from the users table of our database.

constraints.text: database access goes through SQLAlchemy Core; raw sqlite3/psycopg2 connections stay out of application code
constraints.why: the January connection-leak audit traced every leak to hand-managed raw driver connections

constraints.text: query values travel as bound parameters, never string-formatted into the SQL text
constraints.why: a string-formatted WHERE clause opened an injection hole flagged in the spring pentest

checks.description: interpolates the email value into the SQL string
